title: Stranger with Air Force ties at Hart Canyon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Stranger with Air Force ties at Hart Canyon, about 2026 at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: A stranger with curious ties to the Air Force. He showed up at Hart Canyon, which is very obscure and hard to get to at the same time we did.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2026, while visiting Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, a remote spot where some say a craft crashed with alien bodies aboard, a stranger showed up at the same time as his crew. Michels says the man had curious ties to the Air Force, and that it seemed odd for anyone to turn up at such an obscure and hard-to-reach place right when they did.
